#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)

# Read raw match results and filter empty placeholder rows
matches_raw <- read_csv("data/match_results.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(winner) & !is.na(loser))

# Helper to categorize win/loss reason cleanly
categorize_reason <- function(win_type) {
  case_when(
    win_type == "fall" ~ "Pin (Fall)",
    win_type == "decision" ~ "Points (Decision)",
    win_type == "tech fall" ~ "Tech Fall",
    win_type == "forfeit" ~ "Forfeit",
    win_type == "injury default" ~ "Injury Default",
    win_type == "disqualification" ~ "Disqualification",
    win_type == "no contest" ~ "No Contest",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

# Clean score and time details
clean_score_details <- function(score, win_type) {
  case_when(
    is.na(score) | score == "" ~ "—",
    score == "FF" ~ "Forfeit (FF)",
    TRUE ~ score
  )
}

# Extract matches from both winner's and loser's perspectives
wins <- matches_raw |>
  transmute(
    wrestler = winner,
    school = coalesce(winner_team, "Unknown"),
    result = "Win",
    reason = categorize_reason(win_type),
    score_time = clean_score_details(score_details, win_type),
    opponent = loser,
    opponent_school = coalesce(loser_team, "Unknown"),
    weight_class,
    round,
    event_name
  )

losses <- matches_raw |>
  transmute(
    wrestler = loser,
    school = coalesce(loser_team, "Unknown"),
    result = "Loss",
    reason = categorize_reason(win_type),
    score_time = clean_score_details(score_details, win_type),
    opponent = winner,
    opponent_school = coalesce(winner_team, "Unknown"),
    weight_class,
    round,
    event_name
  )

# Combine into one comprehensive dataset sorted by wrestler name and event
wrestler_matches <- bind_rows(wins, losses) |>
  arrange(wrestler, event_name, round)

# Unique values for dropdown filters
events <- sort(unique(wrestler_matches$event_name))
weights <- sort(unique(wrestler_matches$weight_class))
reasons <- sort(unique(wrestler_matches$reason))
total_wrestlers <- length(unique(wrestler_matches$wrestler))
total_matches <- nrow(matches_raw)

# Count wins by reason for top stat cards
pin_count <- sum(matches_raw$win_type == "fall", na.rm = TRUE)
decision_count <- sum(matches_raw$win_type == "decision", na.rm = TRUE)
tf_count <- sum(matches_raw$win_type == "tech fall", na.rm = TRUE)
forfeit_count <- sum(matches_raw$win_type == "forfeit", na.rm = TRUE)

event_options_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<option value="%s">%s</option>', events, events),
  collapse = ""
)

weight_options_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<option value="%s">%s</option>', weights, weights),
  collapse = ""
)

reason_options_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<option value="%s">%s</option>', reasons, reasons),
  collapse = ""
)

# Helper function for result badges
get_result_badge <- function(res) {
  ifelse(
    res == "Win",
    '<span class="badge-win">✓ Win</span>',
    '<span class="badge-loss">✗ Loss</span>'
  )
}

# Helper function for reason badges
get_reason_badge <- function(reason) {
  case_when(
    reason == "Pin (Fall)" ~ '<span class="badge-reason badge-pin">📌 Pin (Fall)</span>',
    reason == "Points (Decision)" ~ '<span class="badge-reason badge-decision">🎯 Points (Dec)</span>',
    reason == "Tech Fall" ~ '<span class="badge-reason badge-tf">⚡ Tech Fall</span>',
    reason == "Forfeit" ~ '<span class="badge-reason badge-forfeit">🏳️ Forfeit</span>',
    reason == "Injury Default" ~ '<span class="badge-reason badge-inj">🩹 Injury Def.</span>',
    reason == "Disqualification" ~ '<span class="badge-reason badge-dq">🚫 DQ</span>',
    TRUE ~ sprintf('<span class="badge-reason badge-other">%s</span>', reason)
  )
}

# Generate table rows
rows_html <- paste(
  sprintf(
    '<tr data-wrestler="%s" data-school="%s" data-opponent="%s" data-event="%s" data-weight="%s" data-result="%s" data-reason="%s">
      <td style="font-weight: 700; color: #1e3a8a;">%s</td>
      <td style="color: #475569;">%s</td>
      <td style="text-align: center;">%s</td>
      <td style="text-align: center;">%s</td>
      <td style="font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.95rem;">%s</td>
      <td style="font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a;">%s</td>
      <td style="color: #64748b; font-size: 0.9rem;">%s</td>
      <td><span class="badge-weight">%s</span></td>
      <td style="font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500;">%s</td>
      <td style="font-size: 0.82rem; color: #64748b;">%s</td>
    </tr>',
    tolower(wrestler_matches$wrestler),
    tolower(wrestler_matches$school),
    tolower(wrestler_matches$opponent),
    wrestler_matches$event_name,
    wrestler_matches$weight_class,
    wrestler_matches$result,
    wrestler_matches$reason,
    wrestler_matches$wrestler,
    wrestler_matches$school,
    get_result_badge(wrestler_matches$result),
    get_reason_badge(wrestler_matches$reason),
    wrestler_matches$score_time,
    wrestler_matches$opponent,
    wrestler_matches$opponent_school,
    wrestler_matches$weight_class,
    wrestler_matches$round,
    wrestler_matches$event_name
  ),
  collapse = ""
)

HTML(paste0(
  '<style>
  .badge-win {
    background-color: #dcfce7;
    color: #166534;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem;
    border-radius: 9999px;

  </style>',
  '<div class="stats-grid">',
  '  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-number">', total_matches, '</div><div class="stat-label">Total Bouts</div></div>',
  '  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-number">', pin_count, '</div><div class="stat-label">Pins (Falls)</div></div>',
  '  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-number">', decision_count, '</div><div class="stat-label">Point Decisions</div></div>',
  '  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-number">', tf_count, '</div><div class="stat-label">Tech Falls</div></div>',
  '  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-number">', forfeit_count, '</div><div class="stat-label">Forfeits</div></div>',
  '</div>',
  '<div class="filter-card">',
  '  <div style="display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end;">',
  '    <div style="flex: 2; min-width: 220px;">',
  '      <label for="matchSearch">Search Wrestler, Opponent, or School</label>',
  '      <input type="text" id="matchSearch" class="form-control" placeholder="Search by name or school..." oninput="filterMatches()" style="padding: 0.45rem;">',
  '    </div>',
  '    <div style="min-width: 160px;">',
  '      <label for="reasonSelect">Reason / Method</label>',
  '      <select id="reasonSelect" class="form-select" style="padding: 0.45rem;" onchange="filterMatches()">',
  '        <option value="all">All Reasons</option>',
  reason_options_html,
  '      </select>',
  '    </div>',
  '    <div style="min-width: 120px;">',
  '      <label for="resultSelect">Result</label>',
  '      <select id="resultSelect" class="form-select" style="padding: 0.45rem;" onchange="filterMatches()">',
  '        <option value="all">All Results</option>',
  '        <option value="Win">Wins Only</option>',
  '        <option value="Loss">Losses Only</option>',
  '      </select>',
  '    </div>',

  '      <select id="eventSelect" class="form-select" style="padding: 0.45rem;" onchange="filterMatches()">',

  event_options_html,
  '      </select>',

  weight_options_html,

  '</table>',
  '<div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; background: #f8fafc; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem;">',
  '  <button id="prevMatchBtn" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" onclick="changeMatchPage(-1)" style="border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;">← Previous</button>',
  '  <span id="matchPageInfo" style="font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #475569;">Page 1</span>',
  '  <button id="nextMatchBtn" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" onclick="changeMatchPage(1)" style="border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;">Next →</button>',
  '</div>',
  '</div>',
  '<script>',
  'let currentMatchPage = 1;',
  'const matchPageSize = 25;',
  'let filteredRows = [];',
  '',
  'function renderMatchPage() {',
  '  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filteredRows.length / matchPageSize));',
  '  if (currentMatchPage > totalPages) currentMatchPage = totalPages;',
  '  if (currentMatchPage < 1) currentMatchPage = 1;',
  '  const allRows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#matchesTable tbody tr"));',
  '  allRows.forEach(r => r.style.display = "none");',
  '  const start = (currentMatchPage - 1) * matchPageSize;',
  '  const end = Math.min(start + matchPageSize, filteredRows.length);',
  '  for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {',
  '    filteredRows[i].style.display = "";',
  '  }',
  '  const countEl = document.getElementById("matchCount");',
  '  if (countEl) {',
  '    if (filteredRows.length === 0) {',
  '      countEl.textContent = "No matches found";',
  '    } else {',
  '      countEl.textContent = "Showing " + (start + 1) + "–" + end + " of " + filteredRows.length + " match records";',
  '    }',
  '  }',
  '  const pageInfo = document.getElementById("matchPageInfo");',
  '  if (pageInfo) pageInfo.textContent = "Page " + currentMatchPage + " of " + totalPages;',
  '  const prevBtn = document.getElementById("prevMatchBtn");',
  '  const nextBtn = document.getElementById("nextMatchBtn");',
  '  if (prevBtn) prevBtn.disabled = (currentMatchPage <= 1);',
  '  if (nextBtn) nextBtn.disabled = (currentMatchPage >= totalPages);',
  '}',
  '',
  'function filterMatches() {',
  '  const search = (document.getElementById("matchSearch").value || "").toLowerCase().trim();',
  '  const selectedEvent = document.getElementById("eventSelect").value;',
  '  const selectedWeight = document.getElementById("weightSelect").value;',
  '  const selectedResult = document.getElementById("resultSelect").value;',
  '  const selectedReason = document.getElementById("reasonSelect").value;',
  '  const allRows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#matchesTable tbody tr"));',
  '  filteredRows = allRows.filter(row => {',
  '    const matchEvent = (selectedEvent === "all" || row.getAttribute("data-event") === selectedEvent);',
  '    const matchWeight = (selectedWeight === "all" || row.getAttribute("data-weight") === selectedWeight);',
  '    const matchResult = (selectedResult === "all" || row.getAttribute("data-result") === selectedResult);',
  '    const matchReason = (selectedReason === "all" || row.getAttribute("data-reason") === selectedReason);',
  '    const wrestlerText = row.getAttribute("data-wrestler") || "";',
  '    const oppText = row.getAttribute("data-opponent") || "";',
  '    const schoolText = row.getAttribute("data-school") || "";',
  '    const matchSearch = (!search || wrestlerText.includes(search) || oppText.includes(search) || schoolText.includes(search));',
  '    return matchEvent && matchWeight && matchResult && matchReason && matchSearch;',
  '  });',
  '  currentMatchPage = 1;',
  '  renderMatchPage();',
  '}',
  '',
  'function changeMatchPage(delta) {',
  '  currentMatchPage += delta;',
  '  renderMatchPage();',
  '  const tableEl = document.getElementById("matchesTable");',
  '  if (tableEl) tableEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });',
  '}',
  '',
  'function makeTableSortable(tableId) {',
  '  const table = document.getElementById(tableId);',
  '  if (!table) return;',
  '  const headers = table.querySelectorAll("thead th");',
  '  headers.forEach((th, colIdx) => {',
  '    th.style.cursor = "pointer";',
  '    th.title = "Click to sort";',
  '    th.setAttribute("data-title", th.textContent.trim());',
  '    th.textContent = th.getAttribute("data-title") + " ↕";',
  '    let asc = true;',
  '    th.addEventListener("click", () => {',
  '      const tbody = table.querySelector("tbody");',
  '      const rows = Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll("tr"));',
  '      rows.sort((a, b) => {',
  '        const valA = a.children[colIdx].textContent.trim();',
  '        const valB = b.children[colIdx].textContent.trim();',
  '        return asc ? valA.localeCompare(valB) : valB.localeCompare(valA);',
  '      });',
  '      rows.forEach(r => tbody.appendChild(r));',
  '      headers.forEach(h => h.textContent = h.getAttribute("data-title") + " ↕");',
  '      th.textContent = th.getAttribute("data-title") + (asc ? " ▲" : " ▼");',
  '      asc = !asc;',
  '      renderMatchPage();',
  '    });',
  '  });',
  '}',
  '',
  'makeTableSortable("matchesTable");',
  'filterMatches();',
  '</script>'
))
